name: ERN Growth & Funding Balance
purpose: Keep Earth Right Now useful enough to deserve repeat visits and financially sustainable enough to continue operating and expanding.

visitorValue.goal: Give people truthful current windows that are useful before travel or simply rewarding to visit virtually.

audienceGrowth.goal: Grow qualified organic discovery and repeat use without spam or misleading promotion.

sustainableFunding.goal: Earn commissions from genuinely useful post-discovery planning actions so ERN can maintain and expand the service.

funnel: Use an optional verified planning action
Partner confirms eligible transaction if one occurs

currentSnapshot.conclusion: The immediate leverage is audience growth and discover-to-plan conversion, not more affiliate-program volume.

fundingPrinciples: Earth discovery remains useful without clicking any commercial link.
Planning actions appear only after destination interest and are clearly disclosed when affiliate or sponsored.
Only current verified links tied to eligible healthy ERN places may count as revenue-capable.
One useful action per need is better than button density.
Commercial performance may prioritize business research effort, never Earth ranking.
No booking, sale, commission or revenue is inferred from a click.
growthPrinciples: Prefer canonical crawlable destination URLs for sharing and search discovery.
Use destination-specific metadata where possible; avoid generic previews when a place page exists.
Grow through helpful content and real current windows, not automated social spam.
Track aggregate referral and destination demand while preserving ERN privacy rules.
Use repeated search gaps and place interest to guide source expansion.
nextUnlockLogic: First partner-confirmed commission is stronger evidence than raw page views.
Sustained planning clicks across multiple destinations can justify broader partner applications.
Meaningful growth in organic visitors and repeat use can justify revisiting stay and transport programs.
No numeric unlock threshold is invented unless a partner explicitly provides one.
protectedInvariants: LINK_ONLY and EXTERNAL sources do not enter Watch Earth merely because they are healthy.
No paid ranking or automatic affiliate placement.
Commission cannot affect source truth, currentness, health or editorial ranking.
